statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a recent transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
The service is ordered to capture arrhythmic burden and correlate rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms
The service is ordered to guide anticoagulation and rate control strategies
The diagnosis codes are I48.0, G45.9, and Z86.73
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
